baselineDisplay.title: 一头小象引发的交通堵塞
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】一头小象引发的交通堵塞
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?
问题：为什么警察必须要把江伯推出主干道？
• 词汇准备
• Christmas 圣诞节
• circus 马戏团
• present 礼物
• accompany 陪伴
• approach 走近
• ought 应该
• weigh 重
• fortunate 幸运的
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children’s hospital.
去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定送些礼物给儿童医院。
Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a ‘guard of honour’ of six pretty girls, he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
他打扮成圣诞老人，在由 6 个漂亮姑娘组成的“仪仗队”的陪同下，骑上一头名叫江伯的小象，沿着城里的主要街道出发了。
He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
他本该知道警察绝不会允许这类事情发生。
A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
一个警察走过来告诉吉米，他应该走一条小路，因为江伯阻碍了交通。
Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move. Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
虽然吉米同意马上就走，但江伯却拒绝移动。15 个警察不得不用很大的力气把它推离主要街道。
The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused. ‘Jumbo must weigh a few tons,’ said a policeman afterwards, ‘so it was fortunate that we didn’t have to carry him. Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.’
警察虽然吃了苦头，但他们还是感到很有趣。“江伯一定有好几吨重，”一个警察事后这样说，“值得庆幸的是它没让我们抬它走。当然，我们应该逮捕它，但由于它一贯表现很好，这次我们饶了它。”
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 What did he decide to take to a children’s hospital? How did the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, dress up? Did he set off down the main street of the city, or did he go down a side street? Was he riding an elephant called Jumbo or not? (After having... and...riding)
2 Was he told that he was holding up the traffic or not? Did Jimmy agree to go at once, or not? Did Jumbo agree to go, or did he refuse to move? How many policemen had to push him off the main street? (On being... but... so...)
3 Did he have a good record or not? Was Jumbo arrested or not? (As … however,...)
Answer: After having decided to take some presents to a children’s hospital, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, dressed up as Father Christmas and set off down the main street of the city riding an elephant called Jumbo. On being told that he was holding up the traffic, Jimmy agreed to go at once but Jumbo refused to move, so fifteen policemen had to push him off the main street. As he had a good record, however, Jumbo was not arrested.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 Jimmy wouldn't have been stopped if ________.
(a) he had gone down a side street
(b) he hadn't ridden an elephant
(c) he had gone down the main street
(d) he hadn't dressed up as Father Christmas
2 One of these statements is true. Which one?
(a) Jumbo was arrested.
(b) Jimmy was arrested.
(c) The police were not amused by what had happened.
(d) The police had difficult time getting Jumbo off the main street.
3 Jimmy _______ Father Christmas.
(a) seemed as
(b) looked like
(c) looked as
(d) seemed
4 He should have known the police wouldn't allow it ________.
(a) and he did
(b) but he didn't
(c) but he couldn't
(d) but he had
5 He ought to have gone along a side street. That's what he ________.
(a) should do
(b) should be doing
(c) should have done
(d) should
6 Jumbo must weigh a few tons. Jumbo _______ a few tons.
(a) probably weighs
(b) has to weigh
(c) ought to weigh
(d) should weigh
7 ________ to carry him?
(a) Did they have
(b) Had they
(c) Must they
(d) Have they
8 He set off down the main street. He _______.
(a) ran
(b) walked
(c) rode
(d) started his journey
9 Jumbo was holding up the traffic. He had _______ cars.
(a) picked up some
(b) sat on some
(c) stopped the
(d) held on to the
10 Jimmy agreed to go at once, but Jumbo ________ to move.
(a) denied
(b) resisted
(c) refused
(d) negated
11 It was fortunate we didn't have to carry him. It was our _______.
(a) good chance
(b) good luck
(c) fortune
(d) fate
12 The police let him off. They _______ him.
(a) allowed
(b) permitted
(c) didn't forbid
(d) didn't punish
Key: 1 a 2 d 3 b 4 b 5 c 6 a 7 a 8 d 9 c 10 c 11 b 12 d
第五十二单元【语法点拨】 主谓一致（下）
▶ 谓语动词用复数
• 某些集合名词如 cattle, police, clergy(牧师,神职人员), poultry(家禽)等作主语时，谓语动词用复数。
• The police are on his track. 警察在跟踪他。
注: people, the people 作“民族”或“种族”解时是可数名词，作主语时，谓语动词用单数。
• Each people builds a culture adapted to its peculiar needs.
每个民族都建立一种适应其独特需要的文化。
▪ 表示成双成对的名词如, trousers, scissors, glasses, clothes, pants(短裤), shorts(短裤), tights(女人的紧身袜裤)等作主语时，若被 a pair of 修饰，谓语动词用单数;否则谓语动词用复数形式。
• Your trousers are worn out. You should mend them.
你的裤子破了，应该补一下。
• There is a pair of scissors on the worktable. 工作台上有把剪刀。
▪ both, few, many, several 等作主语时，谓语动词用复数。
• Both of them like popular songs. 他们两人都喜欢流行歌曲。
• Few people like snakes. 很少有人喜欢蛇。
▶ 谓语动词用单复数
▪ 集合名词如 committee, company, enemy, group, family, flock, public, team 等等。当它指代的集合名词作为一个整体时谓语动词要用单数形式。当它指代一组成员的每个单个个体时，谓语动词用复数。
• The family was united on this question. 全家在这个问题上达成一致。
• My family are always fighting among themselves. 我的家里人总是互相争斗。
• The enemy is suing for peace. 敌人正在寻求和平。
• The enemy were showing up in groups of three or four to turn in their weapons.
敌军三三两两地走出来交了他们的武器。
在英国用法中，集合名词多被用作复数。
• The government have not announced the new policy. 政府还未宣布新政策。
集合名词在同一个结构中不能既作单数又作复数。
• The family is determined to press its claim.
全家一致决定发表其声明。(不可用 their)
▪ English, Chinese, French 等词作主语指语言时，谓语动词用单数，指人民时用复数。
• Chinese is one of the five working languages used in the United Nations.
中文是联合国使用的 5 种工作语言之一。
• The Chinese are very hospitable. 中国人十分好客。
▪ 有些复数名词作主语既可用单数动词，又可用复数动词，一般用单数动词。
(1)以-s 结尾的游戏或疾病名称，如 billiards(台球), bowls(滚木球), measles(麻疹), arthritis(关节炎)等一般作单数用。
• Measles is a contagious disease. 麻疹是一种传染性疾病。
(2)以-ics 结尾的名词作主语，如表示学科，谓语动词用单数；如表示特定的事物，谓语动词用复数。
• Mathematics is a compulsory subject. 数学是一门必修课。
• His mathematics are not so good. 他的数学成绩不太好。
(3)单复数同形的名词作主语，应根据该名词所表示的含义来决定谓语动词的形式。
• The species of fish are numerous. 鱼的种类繁多。
• This species of fish is extinct. 这种鱼已灭绝。
(4)复数名词用作专有名词时，谓语动词用单数。
• The United Nations was founded after World War II ended in 1945.
联合国于 1945 年第二次世界大战后成立。
• Great Expectations was written by Dickens in 1860.
《远大前程》是狄更斯于 1860 年写成的。
(5) lots of, heaps of, loads of (许多,大量)等+名词作主语时，谓语动词单、复数形式取决于其后的名词。
• Lots of people are lining up at the ticket office window.
许多人正在售票窗口排队。
• Lots of money has been saved up. 已经省下了很多钱。
(6)由 variety of 或 number of+名词结构作句子的主语时，若前面有不定冠词 a 时，谓语动词用复数；若前面有定冠词 the 时，谓语动词用单数。
• A number of students were absent yesterday. 昨天有许多学生缺席。
• The number of jobless people grows. 失业人数在增加。
▶ 并列结构作主语的主谓一致
▪ 由 and 或 both…and 连接两个单数形式的名词词组作主语时，一般根据语法一致的原则，谓语动词用复数形式。
• Both he and Sophia were pleased with the girl. 他和索菲娅都喜欢这个女孩。
• Baseball and swimming are usually summer sports.
棒球和游泳通常是夏季运动。
当并列主语在意义上指同一人、同一物或同一概念时，则要根据意义一致的原则,谓语动词用单数形式，否则用复数形式。
• The secretary and accountant of the company was absent at the meeting.
该公司的秘书兼会计没有出席会议。(同一人)
• The secretary and the accountant of the company were absent at the meeting.
该公司的秘书和会计都没有出席会议。(两人)
• Whisky and soda is always my favorite drink.
苏打威士忌总是我最喜欢的饮料。(一种饮料)
▪ 在 each... and each, every…and every, no...and no 等结构之后, 谓语动词用单数形式。
• Each man and each woman is asked to help.
要求每个男人和每个妇女来帮助。
• No teacher and no student has come here today. 今天没有师生来这儿。
▪ 由 not only...but(also), either...or, neither…nor 或 or 连接的并列主语，通常根据就近原则，谓语动词的单、复数形式以最接近的名词(词组)的单复数形式而定。
• Not only the mother but also the children were present.
不仅这位母亲而且孩子们都出席了。
• Neither you nor he is to blame. 你和他都不应受到责备。
• Either you or I am to go. 不是你就是我必须去。
▪ 当主语后面跟有 as well as, as much as, with, along with, like, together with, rather than, except, but, including, accompanied by, plus, besides, in addition to, no less than 等引导的词组时,其谓语动词的单、数形式不受这些短语的影响,通常按语法一致的原则，即按主语的单、复数而定。
• The pilot as well as the passengers has survived the air crash.
飞行员以及乘客在空难中都幸存下来。
• John, as much as his brothers, was responsible for the loss.
约翰和他兄弟一样要对损失负责。
• Jack, more than anyone else, is anxious to go there.
杰克比任何别的人都急于想去那里。
• No one except two servants was late for the dinner.
除了两个仆人外，没有人赴宴迟到。
▪ 在倒装结构中，谓语动词的单、复数形式应与其后的主语保持一致。
• Among the mountains lies a modern hydraulic power station.
在群山之中是一座现代化的水电站。
• Ahead of us lie miles of undulating wilderness.
我们面前是一片起伏不平的荒野。

苏打威士忌总是我最喜欢的饮料。(一种饮料)
▪ 在 each... and each, every…and every, no...and no 等结构之后, 谓语动词用单数形式。

• Each man and each woman is asked to help.
要求每个男人和每个妇女来帮助。
• No teacher and no student has come here today. 今天没有师生来这儿。
▪ 由 not only...but(also), either...or, neither…nor 或 or 连接的并列主语，通常根据就近原则，谓语动词的单、复数形式以最接近的名词(词组)的单复数形式而定。

• Not only the mother but also the children were present.
不仅这位母亲而且孩子们都出席了。
• Neither you nor he is to blame. 你和他都不应受到责备。
• Either you or I am to go. 不是你就是我必须去。

▪ 当主语后面跟有 as well as, as much as, with, along with, like, together with, rather than, except, but, including, accompanied by, plus, besides, in addition to, no less than 等引导的词组时,其谓语动词的单、数形式不受这些短语的影响,通常按语法一致的原则，即按主语的单、复数而定。

• The pilot as well as the passengers has survived the air crash.
飞行员以及乘客在空难中都幸存下来。

• John, as much as his brothers, was responsible for the loss.
约翰和他兄弟一样要对损失负责。

• Jack, more than anyone else, is anxious to go there.
杰克比任何别的人都急于想去那里。

• No one except two servants was late for the dinner.
除了两个仆人外，没有人赴宴迟到。
▪ 在倒装结构中，谓语动词的单、复数形式应与其后的主语保持一致。

• Among the mountains lies a modern hydraulic power station.
在群山之中是一座现代化的水电站。

• Ahead of us lie miles of undulating wilderness.

display.title: 一头小象引发的交通堵塞
display.text:
【故事复现】一头小象引发的交通堵塞
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?
问题：为什么警察必须要把江伯推出主干道？
• 词汇准备
• Christmas 圣诞节
• circus 马戏团
• present 礼物
• accompany 陪伴
• approach 走近
• ought 应该
• weigh 重
• fortunate 幸运的
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children’s hospital.
去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定送些礼物给儿童医院。
Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a ‘guard of honour’ of six pretty girls, he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
他打扮成圣诞老人，在由 6 个漂亮姑娘组成的“仪仗队”的陪同下，骑上一头名叫江伯的小象，沿着城里的主要街道出发了。
He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
他本该知道警察绝不会允许这类事情发生。
A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
一个警察走过来告诉吉米，他应该走一条小路，因为江伯阻碍了交通。
Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move. Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
虽然吉米同意马上就走，但江伯却拒绝移动。15 个警察不得不用很大的力气把它推离主要街道。
The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused. ‘Jumbo must weigh a few tons,’ said a policeman afterwards, ‘so it was fortunate that we didn’t have to carry him. Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.’
警察虽然吃了苦头，但他们还是感到很有趣。“江伯一定有好几吨重，”一个警察事后这样说，“值得庆幸的是它没让我们抬它走。当然，我们应该逮捕它，但由于它一贯表现很好，这次我们饶了它。”
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 What did he decide to take to a children’s hospital? How did the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, dress up? Did he set off down the main street of the city, or did he go down a side street? Was he riding an elephant called Jumbo or not? (After having... and...riding)
2 Was he told that he was holding up the traffic or not? Did Jimmy agree to go at once, or not? Did Jumbo agree to go, or did he refuse to move? How many policemen had to push him off the main street? (On being... but... so...)
3 Did he have a good record or not? Was Jumbo arrested or not? (As … however,...)
Answer: After having decided to take some presents to a children’s hospital, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, dressed up as Father Christmas and set off down the main street of the city riding an elephant called Jumbo. On being told that he was holding up the traffic, Jimmy agreed to go at once but Jumbo refused to move, so fifteen policemen had to push him off the main street. As he had a good record, however, Jumbo was not arrested.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 Jimmy wouldn't have been stopped if ________.
(a) he had gone down a side street
(b) he had ridden a bigger elephant
(c) he had gone down the main street
(d) he hadn't dressed up as Father Christmas
2 One of these statements is true. Which one?
(a) Jumbo was arrested.
(b) Jimmy was arrested.
(c) The police were not amused by what had happened.
(d) The police had a difficult time getting Jumbo off the main street.
3 Jimmy _______ Father Christmas.
(a) seemed as
(b) looked like
(c) looked as
(d) seemed
4 He should have known the police wouldn't allow it ________.
(a) and he did
(b) but he didn't
(c) but he couldn't
(d) but he had
5 He ought to have gone along a side street. That's what he ________.
(a) should do
(b) should be doing
(c) should have done
(d) should
6 Jumbo must weigh a few tons. Jumbo _______ a few tons.
(a) probably weighs
(b) has to weigh
(c) ought to weigh
(d) should weigh
7 ________ to carry him?
(a) Did they have
(b) Had they
(c) Must they
(d) Have they
8 He set off down the main street. He _______.
(a) ran
(b) walked
(c) rode
(d) started his journey
9 Jumbo was holding up the traffic. He had _______ cars.
(a) picked up some
(b) sat on some
(c) stopped the
(d) held on to the
10 Jimmy agreed to go at once, but Jumbo ________ to move.
(a) denied
(b) resisted
(c) refused
(d) negated
11 It was fortunate we didn't have to carry him. It was our _______.
(a) good chance
(b) good luck
(c) fame
(d) fate
12 The police let him off. They _______ him.
(a) allowed
(b) permitted
(c) didn't forbid
(d) didn't punish

第五十二单元【语法点拨】 主谓一致（下）
▶ 谓语动词用复数
• cattle、police 等集合名词通常用复数谓语。clergy 和表示活家禽的 poultry 常按复数理解，但这些词的具体数与意义须结合用法，不能把所有集合名词一概归为复数。
• The police are on his track. 警察在跟踪他。
注：people 表示“人们”时用复数谓语；a people 表示“一个民族”，可用单数谓语，peoples 表示多个民族时用复数。the people 应结合所指意义判断。
• Each people builds a culture adapted to its peculiar needs.
每个民族都建立一种适应其独特需要的文化。
▪ trousers、scissors、glasses、pants、shorts、tights 等通常以复数形式使用，谓语用复数；a pair of ... 作主语时，中心词 pair 为单数，谓语用单数。clothes 也是复数用法，但通常不说 a pair of clothes。pants 在美式英语中常指长裤，在英式英语中常指内裤。
• Your trousers are worn out. You should mend them.
你的裤子破了，应该补一下。
• There is a pair of scissors on the worktable. 工作台上有把剪刀。
▪ both, few, many, several 等作主语时，谓语动词用复数。
• Both of them like popular songs. 他们两人都喜欢流行歌曲。
• Few people like snakes. 很少有人喜欢蛇。
▶ 谓语动词用单复数
▪ committee、company、group、family、team 等集合名词，强调整体时可用单数，强调成员时可用复数，后者在英式英语中尤其常见；美式英语通常更偏好单数或明确写出 members。
• The family was united on this question. 全家在这个问题上达成一致。
• My family are always fighting among themselves. 我的家里人总是互相争斗。
• The enemy is suing for peace. 敌人正在寻求和平。
• The enemy were showing up in groups of three or four to turn in their weapons.
敌军三三两两地走出来交了他们的武器。
英式英语中，集合名词使用复数谓语比美式英语更常见，仍须结合所指是整体还是成员来理解。
• The government have not announced the new policy. 政府还未宣布新政策。
谓语和代词应保持清晰、自然的指代。学习写作时可将整体读法与成员读法保持一致，但实际英语也有单数谓语配复数代词的意义一致现象，不能一律判错。
• The family is determined to press its claim.
全家决心坚持自己的诉求。
这里用 is 和 its 表示家庭整体；若强调家人，可改写为 The family members are determined to press their claim.
▪ English, Chinese, French 等词作主语指语言时，谓语动词用单数，指人民时用复数。
• Chinese is one of the six official languages of the United Nations.
中文是联合国六种正式语言之一。
• The Chinese are very hospitable. 中国人十分好客。
▪ 以下名词的词尾或表面形式容易误导判断，应分别按词义和用法处理。
(1)游戏或疾病名称中，有些词虽然以-s 结尾，如 billiards(台球), bowls(滚木球), measles(麻疹), arthritis(关节炎)等一般作单数用。
• Measles is a contagious disease. 麻疹是一种传染性疾病。
(2)以-ics 结尾的名词作主语，如表示学科，谓语动词用单数；如表示特定的事物，谓语动词用复数。
• Mathematics is a compulsory subject. 数学是一门必修课。
• His statistics are inaccurate. 他的统计数据不准确。
(3)单复数同形的名词作主语，应根据该名词所表示的含义来决定谓语动词的形式。
• The species of fish are numerous. 鱼的种类繁多。
• This species of fish is extinct. 这种鱼已灭绝。
(4)复数形式用作一本书或一个机构等专有名称时，常按单一对象使用单数谓语，并非所有复数专名都如此。
• The United Nations was founded after World War II ended in 1945.
联合国于 1945 年第二次世界大战后成立。
• Great Expectations was written by Dickens in 1860–1861.
《远大前程》是狄更斯于1860至1861年创作的。
(5) lots of, heaps of, loads of (许多,大量)等+名词作主语时，谓语动词单、复数形式取决于其后的名词。
• Lots of people are lining up at the ticket office window.
许多人正在售票窗口排队。
• Lots of money has been saved up. 已经省下了很多钱。
▪ a number of + 复数名词表示“许多”，谓语用复数；the number of ... 表示“……的数量”，谓语用单数。a variety of ... 可按多种事物用复数，也可在强调整体种类范围时用单数，不能与 number 的规则完全等同。
• A number of students were absent yesterday. 昨天有许多学生缺席。
• The number of jobless people grows. 失业人数在增加。
▶ 并列结构作主语的主谓一致
▪ 由 and 或 both…and 连接两个单数形式的名词词组作主语时，一般根据语法一致的原则，谓语动词用复数形式。
• Both he and Sophia were pleased with the girl. 他和索菲娅都喜欢这个女孩。
• Baseball and swimming are usually summer sports.
棒球和游泳通常是夏季运动。
当并列主语在意义上指同一人、同一物或同一概念时，则要根据意义一致的原则,谓语动词用单数形式，否则用复数形式。
• The secretary and accountant of the company was absent at the meeting.
该公司的秘书兼会计没有出席会议。(同一人)
• The secretary and the accountant of the company were absent at the meeting.
该公司的秘书和会计都没有出席会议。(两人)
• Whisky and soda is always my favorite drink.
苏打威士忌总是我最喜欢的饮料。(一种饮料)
▪ 在 each... and each, every…and every, no...and no 等结构之后, 谓语动词用单数形式。
• Each man and each woman is asked to help.
要求每个男人和每个妇女来帮助。
• No teacher and no student has come here today. 今天没有师生来这儿。
▪ 由 not only...but(also), either...or, neither…nor 或 or 连接的并列主语，通常根据就近原则，谓语动词的单、复数形式以最接近的名词(词组)的单复数形式而定。
• Not only the mother but also the children were present.
不仅这位母亲而且孩子们都出席了。
• Neither you nor he is to blame. 你和他都不应受到责备。
• Either you or I am to go. 不是你就是我必须去。
▪ 主语后的 with、along with、together with、as well as、including 等补充词组通常不改变主语的单复数，谓语与真正的主语一致。plus 等词若按并列而非补充关系使用，须另据结构判断。
• The pilot as well as the passengers has survived the air crash.
飞行员以及乘客在空难中都幸存下来。
• John, as much as his brothers, was responsible for the loss.
约翰和他兄弟一样要对损失负责。
• Jack, more than anyone else, is anxious to go there.
杰克比任何别的人都急于想去那里。
• No one except two servants was late for the dinner.
除了两个仆人外，没有人赴宴迟到。
▪ 在倒装结构中，谓语动词的单、复数形式应与其后的主语保持一致。
• Among the mountains lies a modern hydraulic power station.
在群山之中是一座现代化的水电站。
• Ahead of us lie miles of undulating wilderness.
我们面前是一片起伏不平的荒野。

• The family is determined to press its claim.
全家决心坚持自己的诉求。
这里用 is 和 its 表示家庭整体；若强调家人，可改写为 The family members are determined to press their claim.
▪ English, Chinese, French 等词作主语指语言时，谓语动词用单数，指人民时用复数。

• Chinese is one of the six official languages of the United Nations.
中文是联合国六种正式语言之一。
• The Chinese are very hospitable. 中国人十分好客。
▪ 以下名词的词尾或表面形式容易误导判断，应分别按词义和用法处理。
(1)游戏或疾病名称中，有些词虽然以-s 结尾，如 billiards(台球), bowls(滚木球), measles(麻疹), arthritis(关节炎)等一般作单数用。
• Measles is a contagious disease. 麻疹是一种传染性疾病。
(2)以-ics 结尾的名词作主语，如表示学科，谓语动词用单数；如表示特定的事物，谓语动词用复数。
• Mathematics is a compulsory subject. 数学是一门必修课。
• His statistics are inaccurate. 他的统计数据不准确。
(3)单复数同形的名词作主语，应根据该名词所表示的含义来决定谓语动词的形式。
• The species of fish are numerous. 鱼的种类繁多。
• This species of fish is extinct. 这种鱼已灭绝。
(4)复数形式用作一本书或一个机构等专有名称时，常按单一对象使用单数谓语，并非所有复数专名都如此。

• The United Nations was founded after World War II ended in 1945.
联合国于 1945 年第二次世界大战后成立。

• Great Expectations was written by Dickens in 1860–1861.
《远大前程》是狄更斯于1860至1861年创作的。
(5) lots of, heaps of, loads of (许多,大量)等+名词作主语时，谓语动词单、复数形式取决于其后的名词。

• Lots of people are lining up at the ticket office window.
许多人正在售票窗口排队。
• Lots of money has been saved up. 已经省下了很多钱。
▪ a number of + 复数名词表示“许多”，谓语用复数；the number of ... 表示“……的数量”，谓语用单数。a variety of ... 可按多种事物用复数，也可在强调整体种类范围时用单数，不能与 number 的规则完全等同。
• A number of students were absent yesterday. 昨天有许多学生缺席。
• The number of jobless people grows. 失业人数在增加。
▶ 并列结构作主语的主谓一致
▪ 由 and 或 both…and 连接两个单数形式的名词词组作主语时，一般根据语法一致的原则，谓语动词用复数形式。
• Both he and Sophia were pleased with the girl. 他和索菲娅都喜欢这个女孩。

• Baseball and swimming are usually summer sports.
棒球和游泳通常是夏季运动。
当并列主语在意义上指同一人、同一物或同一概念时，则要根据意义一致的原则,谓语动词用单数形式，否则用复数形式。

• The secretary and accountant of the company was absent at the meeting.
该公司的秘书兼会计没有出席会议。(同一人)

• The secretary and the accountant of the company were absent at the meeting.
该公司的秘书和会计都没有出席会议。(两人)

• Whisky and soda is always my favorite drink.
苏打威士忌总是我最喜欢的饮料。(一种饮料)
▪ 在 each... and each, every…and every, no...and no 等结构之后, 谓语动词用单数形式。

• Each man and each woman is asked to help.
要求每个男人和每个妇女来帮助。
• No teacher and no student has come here today. 今天没有师生来这儿。
▪ 由 not only...but(also), either...or, neither…nor 或 or 连接的并列主语，通常根据就近原则，谓语动词的单、复数形式以最接近的名词(词组)的单复数形式而定。

• Not only the mother but also the children were present.
不仅这位母亲而且孩子们都出席了。
• Neither you nor he is to blame. 你和他都不应受到责备。
• Either you or I am to go. 不是你就是我必须去。
▪ 主语后的 with、along with、together with、as well as、including 等补充词组通常不改变主语的单复数，谓语与真正的主语一致。plus 等词若按并列而非补充关系使用，须另据结构判断。

• The pilot as well as the passengers has survived the air crash.
飞行员以及乘客在空难中都幸存下来。

• John, as much as his brothers, was responsible for the loss.
约翰和他兄弟一样要对损失负责。

• Jack, more than anyone else, is anxious to go there.
杰克比任何别的人都急于想去那里。

• No one except two servants was late for the dinner.
除了两个仆人外，没有人赴宴迟到。
▪ 在倒装结构中，谓语动词的单、复数形式应与其后的主语保持一致。

• Among the mountains lies a modern hydraulic power station.
在群山之中是一座现代化的水电站。

• Ahead of us lie miles of undulating wilderness.
我们面前是一片起伏不平的荒野。
